description: Alterations to shopfront with installation of projecting and fascia sign alterations to basement and ground floor including refurbishment of ground floor and basement retail area; minor changes in existing lighting and redecoration, installation of quantity of plasterboard walls in basement area; installation of decorative floating millwork partitions in basement and ground floor areas; modification to electrical system, installation of new floor in retail area above existing flooring;  modification to shopfront elevation consisting of replacement tiles in stepped area, addition of tiled panels to fascia, painting of shopfront frame, installation of back-lit glass logo, and installation of lightbox projecting sign
